text:
Jordan: quick ping — PR #2864 is ready but Olivia flagged a naming/lint nit. Can someone give a final thumbs? I'll hold merge until we align on the name choice.

Maria: looked at it briefly. main nit is the identifier casing: `requestID` vs `requestId` across pkg/service. prefer `requestID` to match other initialisms in repo, but not a hard block. also please run `gofmt`.

Tyler: +1 for `requestID`. also two files have trailing whitespace and a small test name mismatch. easy fixes.

Olivia: quick note — in the helper module we use `reqID` elsewhere. I suggested `reqID` to keep local consistency, but ok if this API surface is public we should keep the existing `requestID` pattern.

Jordan: good point — this touches a public struct. changing to `reqID` could break callers. my preference: keep `requestID` now and file a follow-up to standardize small helper libs.

Olivia: sounds reasonable. I'll drop that as a blocking comment.

Sam: formatting nit: run `gofmt -w .` and then `git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit` if you want to squash formatting into the existing commit.

ci-bot: Build passed — linux-amd64, unit tests OK, lint fixed in CI run 3421.

Maria: anything else blocking merge?

Olivia: lgtm after formatting + one tiny rename in kvcache_test.go line ~42 (test variable name is misleading).

Jordan: thanks — pushing a tiny fmt + rename patch now. Will wait for CI and merge once green. @Tyler @Maria if you want to quick re-review after I push.

Tyler: will re-review in ~30m.

Maria: merging once CI is green. :shipit:
